lakes.name: Lake Dunmore
lakes.clarity: Clear mesotrophic; Secchi ~5.5–6.5 m; 105 ft deep; milfoil actively managed (DEC LMP)
lakes.motors: Unrestricted HP; traditional ski/tube statewide-exempt; on DEC 2026 wakesports-zone list
lakes.blurb: Moosalamoo/GMNF wall of forest, real ski water, best drive-to-quality ratio; summer-busy shore and thin inventory.

lakes.name: Crystal Lake (Barton)
lakes.clarity: Oligo-mesotrophic; Secchi ~6 m; 106 ft deep (DEC bathymetry); small milfoil population under treatment
lakes.motors: Unrestricted HP; DEC wakesports zone designated
lakes.blurb: Cliff-walled, deep and clear with true camp stock; Rt 5 west shore and village parks at north end temper it.

lakes.name: Harvey's Lake (Barnet)
lakes.clarity: Meso-oligotrophic; ~140 ft deep; Secchi ~5.5–6.5 m; Cousteau's first dive; healthy native plants (VPR/DEC)
lakes.motors: Motors unrestricted, high-speed legal (UPW table); DEC wakesports zone
lakes.blurb: The small-gem exception: deep, clear, hushed West Barnet, closest NEK water; 351 ac means modest ski room.

lakes.name: Little Averill Pond
lakes.clarity: Oligotrophic reference-grade; Secchi ~7 m+; loon nesting lake
lakes.motors: Unrestricted; DEC wakesports zone designated (2026 list)
lakes.blurb: Wildest clear water on this list; 7-hour edge, rough camp roads, almost no market—patience play beside Great Averill.

lakes.name: Lake Fairlee
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic; Secchi starts high, declines through summer; internal P loading noted (DEC LMP 2023)
lakes.motors: Unrestricted; NOT on 2026 wakesports list (trad ski/tube still legal)
lakes.blurb: Forested, quiet, 4:40 out, youth-camp culture; squeaks the size bar and clarity is good-not-great.

lakes.name: Island Pond (Brighton)
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic; Secchi ~4.5–5 m; forested south/east shores, state park
lakes.blurb: Big cheap water with Brighton SP forest; village, rail line and middling clarity keep it off the podium.

lakes.name: Lake Salem (Derby)
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic; Secchi ~4–5 m; milfoil-prevention program active; occasional bloom notices
lakes.blurb: Serious acreage and one true compound listing; Rt 105 shore, Derby sprawl and softer water are the caveats.

lakes.name: Lake Morey
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic, alum-treated (35-ft wakesports floor protects treatment); Secchi ~4.5 m
lakes.motors: 40 mph cap (UPW table)—skiing fine; DEC wakesports zone
lakes.blurb: Closest legal ski water with a zone; cottage-ringed resort lake, engineered water quality—not the forested archetype.
